summary: Tested FR/EN instant translation feature. All translation functionality works correctly: navigation, Admin tabs (18 tabs), Admin content, homepage, and language persistence after page reload.

features_tested.notes: Toggle button [data-testid='language-toggle'] works correctly. Clicking toggles between FR and EN. Shows flag emoji (🇫🇷/🇬🇧) based on current language.
All navigation items translate correctly: ACCUEIL, TABLEAU DE BORD, INTELLIGENCE, CARTE, SORTIES, ANALYSEZ, MAGASIN
All navigation items translate correctly: HOME, DASHBOARD, INTELLIGENCE, MAP, TRIPS, ANALYZE, SHOP
Hero section translates: FR='Votre parcours guidé vers une chasse parfaite', EN='Your guided path to a perfect hunt'. Buttons: Analysez/Analyze, Comparez/Compare, Commandez/Order

All 18 admin tabs translate correctly between FR and EN: Dashboard/Tableau de bord, Sales/Ventes, Products/Produits, Partners/Partenaires, Customers/Clients, Commissions, Performance/Performances, Categories/Catégories, SEO Content/Contenu SEO, BACKUP, Site Access/Accès Site, Hotspots, Networking/Réseautage, Email, Marketing, Partners/Partenaires, Controls/Contrôles, Identity/Identité

Admin dashboard content translates: Products/Produits, Orders/Commandes, Total Sales/Ventes totales, Net Margins/Marges nettes, Dropshipping, Affiliate/Affiliation, Pending/En attente, Confirmed/Confirmées, Paid/Payées
Language preference persists in localStorage (key: 'bionic_language'). After page reload, selected language is maintained.
Cookie consent banner translates: FR='Respect de votre vie privée', buttons: Tout accepter/Personnaliser/Refuser tout
